description: Security scanner for AI/ML model files. Detects malicious code, backdoors, and vulnerabilities before deployment

written.description: Covers the widest range of model formats of any of these, emits SARIF for a CI gate, and says plainly where its own analysis was bounded rather than reporting clean.

Allow the Ubuntu Python 3.13 package lane 30 minutes after its tests passed but the build reached the 15-minute limit. All tests and artifact checks remain enabled.

Give this lane the same 30-minute budget as Ubuntu Python 3.13 and 3.14, preserving all tests, Rust checks, builds and wheel consumers. The existing platform/ABI workflow contract and full Ruff checks pass.

* fix(ci): allow Intel macOS Python 3.12 package tests to finish

* fix(ci): allow Windows Python 3.14 package validation to finish

The current parent lane passed in 58 minutes 45 seconds, while the identical root package lane reached 98 percent before its 60-minute limit. Give Windows Python 3.14 the same 75-minute budget as Intel macOS Python 3.14, preserving every test, Rust check, package build and wheel consumer. The existing platform/ABI workflow contract and full Ruff checks pass.
